backgrounds.orchard: Photorealistic horizontal film still of the Garden of Eden at golden evening. Eye-level camera, with the horizon about two-thirds of the way up the frame. Lush untouched grass below it, the Tree of Knowledge at the center background, heavy with red apples, a serpent coiled around one of its branches. Far in the background, small and out of focus, a man and a woman, modestly covered by leaves and drapery, stand together near the foot of the tree — she reaches up toward an apple on a low branch, offering it to him. No one else in the frame. Soft low golden evening sunlight from the background, glowing through the trees and warming the grass in front, soft gentle contrast, natural colours, natural film look. A calm, empty foreground.
backgrounds.moon: Photorealistic horizontal film still at the Apollo 11 Moon landing site, 1969. The camera is a normal eye-level view, 1.5 metres (5 feet) above the ground, about 6 metres in front of the lunar excursion module. The module is a real spacecraft 7 metres/23 feet tall, four times the height of a standing man, and is drawn at that true scale: it fills the centre and the whole upper part of the frame and rises beyond the top edge, so its top is not visible. Its gold-foil descent stage, its ladder with rungs about 40 cm apart, its leg struts and its round footpads each look huge next to a person; its footpads rest on the ground at the very bottom edge of the frame. The grey dusty lunar surface fills the lower third; the horizon lies about two-thirds of the way down the frame, with a pure black sky above it and the small blue Earth in the upper right. Far away on the horizon at the left, tiny, an American flag stands in the dust, and a single astronaut in a bulky white spacesuit walks very far in the distance, only a few pixels tall, with no visor or suit detail readable. No one else in the frame. A clear, empty foreground of dust in the bottom centre of the frame. Low white sunlight from behind and to the right of the lander, casting long shadows across the dust to the left and toward the camera, soft gentle contrast, natural film look.

The thick trunk of the Tree of Knowledge rises from the centre and its wide canopy, heavy with red apples, spreads across the upper two thirds of the frame against a warm golden sky; a serpent is coiled around one low branch on the right. Far in the background, small and out of focus, a man and a woman, modestly covered by leaves and drapery, stand together near the foot of the tree. No one else in the frame. Soft low golden evening sunlight from the background, glowing through the trees and warming the grass in front, soft gentle contrast, natural colours, natural film look. A calm, empty foreground of grass in the bottom centre of the frame.

Lush untouched grass covers the lower two thirds of the frame, with the Tree of Knowledge at the centre background, heavy with red apples, a serpent coiled around one of its branches, and soft green bushes and flowering shrubs around it. Far in the background, small and out of focus, a man and a woman, modestly covered by leaves and drapery, stand together near the foot of the tree. The horizon lies about one third of the way down the frame. No one else in the frame. Soft low golden evening sunlight from the background, glowing through the trees and warming the grass in front, soft gentle contrast, natural colours, natural film look. A calm, empty foreground of grass in the bottom centre of the frame.

backgrounds.cliff: Photorealistic horizontal film still at dusk on a bare rocky mountain summit, eye-level camera 1.5 metres above a flat stone platform. The platform fills the bottom third of the frame and is empty. The horizon lies about one half of the way up the frame and is visibly curved, the edge of the Earth, with a sea of low pink and orange clouds far below it. Above, the sky shades from deep blue to near black, with the first stars. Far away at the left edge of the frame, small and softly out of focus, an old black cast-iron cannon on a wooden carriage stands on the rock, pointing toward the horizon. No people in the frame. Low warm sunlight from behind the camera and slightly to the left, soft gentle contrast, natural colours, natural film look. A clear, empty foreground of stone in the bottom centre of the frame.
backgrounds.space: Photorealistic horizontal film still on a flat grey rocky surface of a small airless body in deep space, eye-level camera 1.5 metres above the ground. The grey dusty rock fills the bottom third of the frame and is empty. The horizon lies about two thirds of the way down the frame, under a pure black sky dense with sharp stars. Far away in the upper centre, small, two bright blue-white stars close together circle each other, with a faint soft glow between them; no rings, diagrams, lines or text are drawn anywhere. No people in the frame. Cool white light from behind the camera and slightly to the left, soft gentle contrast, natural film look. A clear, empty foreground of rock in the bottom centre of the frame.
